lessons.trigger_condition: BOX tile did not separately display observed price range and withheld selling recommendations; undated or mixed sealed variant references could be misleading.
lessons.prevention_rule: Same game, country, one sealed BOX and KRW identity; 30-day observed evidence; do not promote asking or single-source reference into completed-sale recommendation; require reviewed event, independent sources, 7-day freshness and explicit provenance.
validation_required: Exact baseline main and functional candidate commits remain ancestors
Current HEAD JS/CSS Git blob matches independently pinned bytes
No further watched changes after candidate
Reviews use original publisher source and real sale event IDs
Never claim Lenovo real-device validation from CI
lessons.safety_boundary: Read-only on-device comparison; no price invention, paid sources, model auto-rewrite or portfolio modification.
